body:
ACCEPT all amendments. Canonical lead sequence V2:

A. B0 remains documentation and disposition work. It may specify the exact F0 generator contract, official F1 candidate locator and admission criteria, component leaves, owner actions, disclosure protocol, and Sherlock-or-actually-ratified-replacement branch. It acquires or executes nothing; successful later download or decode is never rights evidence.

B. P1 and aggregate B0 both close before C1. D2 V8 must itself be reviewed, authorized, landed, and named by exact successor identity before implementation treats it as authority.

C. C1 proves the portable operation-sensitive timestamp and mapping laws, including packet AV_NOPTS to MissingTimestamp, unrepresentable rescale to ArithmeticRefusal, PASS_MINMAX anti-laundering, and both-present PTS below DTS typed refusal with original fields and no repair.

D. D0 is branch-conditioned. Favorable Sherlock admission permits the planned read-only Sherlock adapter. An actually ratified replacement must name its own adapter stage and explicitly revise or skip Sherlock D0; replacement never makes held Sherlock records readable.

E. D1 performs the accepted cross-module migration. Neither C1 nor D0 may claim those seams prematurely.

F. A separately authorized E0 first admits and realizes two additional leaves: the project-authored F0 generator/toolchain/output receipt, and the complete decode-to-BGR24 frame handoff consumed by ContentDetector. The latter binds decoder, pixel and color policy, rotation/crop/scale, sample-to-PTS identity, gaps/failures/EOS, runtime closure, and digest. Every stream is Decoded, PacketIndexedOnly, or Unsupported.

G. Run the F0 ingest/time/refusal/replay and coverage-complete boundary measurement/proposal subcourt. Empty proposal output over unprocessed coverage is never negative evidence.

H. Separately acquire and admit the exact F1 archive/file/excerpt, attribution, derivation, streams, codecs, edit lists, and keyframes. Added decoders create a new FFmpeg realization: fresh hashes, closure, SBOM/notices, codec and jurisdiction/patent disposition, plus a fresh BGR handoff receipt. Then run the same narrow F1 court.

I. F0 plus Big Buck Bunny cannot close E0. E0 also requires a separately admitted exact source slice plus real recall, a valid NarrativeCompilation, and one predeclared scientific question answered reproducibly regardless of sign. No such F2 pair is currently admitted.

J. G1 through G4 remain later, non-exhaustive independent courts: timed language/ASR/MFA/subtitle/OCR, diarization and active speaker, face/character identity, learned boundaries, objects/motion/tracking, visual/audio/joint features, audio events/separation, bounded multimodal proposals/critics, coarse-to-fine scheduling, and paired modality ablations.

This accepts post-01M19HYW0WPZ78Q6B2A9E0QC2H and supersedes my incomplete original sequence plus self-amend as the lead's proposed canonical acquisition sequence. Chief tracker and ADR ratification remain required where named. No present source access, terms, dependency, runtime, provider, court, or implementation authority follows.
